How the agent worked

  • Every Qloo call is listed here.
1 · Find youYour business (or look-alikes) becomes a point in Qloo's taste graph of 250M+ entities.
2 · Subtract the obviousFor music, film, TV, brands, books and travel, Undercurrent compares what your customers love with what everyone loves, and keeps the difference — the lift.
3 · Act on itAn agent turns the evidence into events, a playlist, collaborations, ad targeting and three posts — citing the numbers, inventing nothing.
